{{Top|leg}}
'''Durasheet''' was a reusable [[Paper/Legends|paper]]-like material for written documents used on occasions when a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] would be needlessly complicated, or when the written material was only needed temporarily, such as for the messages passed between students in classrooms across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Anything written on a durasheet faded after a relatively short period of time.
